text.p: Vaughn Communications Inc said Tuesday it acquired for undisclosed terms, its competitor, Dub South, an Atlanta video tape duplicator.
Dub South and Vaughn each operate in Atlanta and will merge into one facility. Dub South, with sales of just under $2 million, services the corporate video market.
"We are now the leading supplier of our services in the rapidly growing Atlanta market," Vaughn President Don Drapeau said in a news release.

Vaughn also said it added CD replication to its list of services through acquisition of Fremont, Calif. based Certified Media Corp. Certified Media offers medium to large volume replication of CD ROM media, and duplicates computer diskettes.

In a related move, Vaughn's Minneapolis branch installed a CDR duplication system in its production facility. With this equipment, Vaughn will serve customers that need small quantities of CD copies on very quick turn around.

Vaughn currently operates duplication facilities in 12 cities and has 20 sales offices nationally, providing large capacity, high speed duplication. Vaughn's market includes corporate, educational, religious, and other institutional users of video tape for marketing and communications.
